scope: scheduled sensor CSV path confinement and worker mount contract
implementation: Scheduled sensor driver implementations must expose fetch_scheduled; the registry loader checks that contract before use.
The built-in CSV scheduled fetch confines file_path to KOKONUT_SENSOR_CSV_ROOT and rejects traversal, outside-root paths, symlinked path components, missing roots, and non-regular files.
The root and every directory/file component are opened with O_NOFOLLOW using descriptor-relative traversal.
Legacy worker, Kernel standard, and Kernel portability Compose worker profiles mount the configured host input directory read-only at /var/lib/kokonut/sensor-inputs.
Manual CSV and driver operations remain unchanged.
